REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF NORTH GORONTALO

REGENT OF NORTH GORONTALO

DECIDES:

To Establish: REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

heading: CHAPTER I
translated_text:
CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is North Gorontalo Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of government affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
3. Regent is the Regent of North Gorontalo.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution positioned as an element of the Regional Government administration.
5. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the regional head and DPRD in the administration of Government Affairs that are the authority of the Region.
6. Forum for the Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FP2ATK is a forum established based on this Regional Regulation whose membership comes from related agencies and communities concerned with protection from acts of violence.
7. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
8. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and organizations and/or community organizations.
9. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband, wife, or husband, wife and their child, or father and his child, or mother and her child, or blood relatives in a direct line upward or downward up to the third degree.
10. Every person is an individual or corporation.
11. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually, economically, socially, psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or private life.
13. Violence against children is any action that results in or may result in suffering of children physically, sexually, economically, socially and psychologically.
14. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
15. Protection of women is all activities aimed at providing a sense of security carried out by the police, prosecution service, courts, social institutions, or other parties who know or hear that violence against women will or has occurred.
16. Child Protection is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and dignity, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
17. Special Protection is a form of protection received by Children in certain situations and conditions to obtain a guarantee of security against threats that endanger themselves and their lives in their growth and development.
18. Cooperation is an activity or effort carried out by several people to achieve common goals.
19. Service is an action taken as soon as possible to victims when seeing, hearing and knowing that violence against victims will, is or has occurred.
20. Companion is a social worker who has professional competence in their field.

21. Victim recovery is all efforts to strengthen victims of domestic violence to be more empowered, both physically and psychologically.

22. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment hereinafter referred to as P2TP2A is an integrated service provider institution for victims established by the Regional Government.

heading: CHAPTER II
Article 3
translated_text:
Article 3

Protection of Women and Children from Acts of Violence aims to:

a. prevent all forms of Violence against Women and Children;
b. protect Women and provide services to Women and Child Victims of Acts of Violence; and
c. empower Women and Child Victims of Acts of Violence.

heading: CHAPTER III
translated_text:
CHAPTER III

SCOPE

Article 4

The Scope of this Regional Regulation consists of:

a. protection of women; and
b. protection of children.

heading: Article 5
Article 6
translated_text:
Article 6

Protection of children as referred to in Article 4 letter b includes:

a. protection of children who are victims of acts of violence; and
b. special protection of children.

heading: Article 27
translated_text:
Article 27

1. The Regional Government encourages the business sector to participate in the protection of women and children from acts of violence;
2. Participation as referred to in paragraph (1) may take the form of: a. dissemination/outreach to employees within the company environment regarding the dangers of acts of violence against women and children; and
b. assistance as a form of corporate social responsibility.

heading: CHAPTER IX
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX

INFORMATION AND REPORTING SYSTEM

Article 28

1. The Regional Government prepares and compiles an information and reporting system for the protection of women and children from acts of violence;
2. The information and reporting system as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

heading: CHAPTER X
CHAPTER X
translated_text:
CHAPTER X

FINANCING

Article 30

Financing for the activities of Protection of Women and Children from acts of violence may be sourced from:

a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget; and/or
b. other legitimate and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

heading: CHAPTER X I
translated_text:
CHAPTER X I

TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS

Article 31

In the event that FP2ATK as referred to in Article 18 has not been established, the existing P2TP2A shall continue to carry out the duties and functions of integrated services for Women and children victims of acts of Violence in the Region.

heading: CHAPTER XII
translated_text:
CHAPTER XII

CLOSING PROVISIONS

Article 32

Implementing regulations of this Regional Regulation must be stipulated no later than 6 (six) months from the promulgation of this Regional Regulation.

heading: Article 33
translated_text:
Article 33

This Regional Regulation comes into force on the date of promulgation. So that everyone may know of it, orders the promulgation of this Regional Regulation by placing it in the Regional Gazette of North Gorontalo Regency.

heading: ELUCIDATION
translated_text:
ELUCIDATION

OF

REGIONAL REGULATION OF NORTH GORONTALO

NUMBER YEAR 2019

CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I . GENERAL

Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights so that their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and destiny without discrimination. In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in North Gorontalo Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of regional regulations. So far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not regulated protection efforts in the Region, so institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee their implementation. Regional Regulations regulate protection efforts for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in North Gorontalo Regency

Article 6

Sufficiently clear Letter a What is meant by "physical violence" is any act that results in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, unconsciousness and or causes death Letter b What is meant by "sexual violence" is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced unnatural or unwanted sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

Letter c What is meant by "economic violence" is an act that restricts a person from working inside or outside the home to earn money and goods, including allowing a working person to be exploited, while someone does not fulfill the economic needs of the family.

Letter d What is meant by "social violence" is an act by a person or group of people that causes injury or loss of life to a person or may cause physical damage or damage to another person's property Letter e What is meant by "psychological violence" is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and or severe psychological suffering to a person.

Letter f What is meant by "Domestic Neglect" is:

a. actions that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of children properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social;
b. actions that deliberately neglect to maintain, care for, or look after children as they should;
c. actions that neglect people within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or because of an agreement or contract they are obliged to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person;
d. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

e. actions that result in economic dependence by restricting and/or prohibiting decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

Letter g Sufficiently clear.

Letter h What is meant by "threat of certain actions" is any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that create fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.

Paragraph (1) Letter a What is meant by "complaint service" is a series of actions carried out by integrated service providers to follow up on reports of acts of violence against women and children submitted by victims, families or the community.

Letter b What is meant by "health services" is efforts that include promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative aspects.

Letter c What is meant by "counseling" is a process of providing objective and complete information, carried out systematically with interpersonal communication guidance, guidance techniques and mastery of clinical knowledge aimed at helping a person recognize their current condition, the problems being faced, and determine solutions or efforts to overcome these problems.

Letter d What is meant by "spiritual guidance" is a form of activity in which there is a process of spiritual guidance and coaching to humans so as to provide peace, tranquility and coolness of heart to humans by always providing encouragement and motivation to remain patient, trusting in God and continue to carry out their obligations.

Letter e What is meant by "social rehabilitation services" is services aimed at restoring and developing the abilities of a person experiencing social dysfunction so that they can carry out their social functions properly.

Letter f What is meant by "legal aid and assistance services" is legal services provided by legal assistants or advocates to carry out the process of accompanying witnesses and/or victims of violence against women and children that is gender sensitive.

Letter g What is meant by "repatriation and reintegration" is the effort to return women and child victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.
